title: One serpentine through cut frees two parts; a wheel on the second between its detachment and the end of the cut
rationale: One continuous through cut first closes the 37 mm bridge of a small part below the trim (event 1: nothing stands on it), then runs on through removed material and closes the trim's 30 mm bridge (event 2: the interior, with the rear and right wheels on it, is cut free), then cuts 100 mm more. The wheels are on detached material from event 2 on, in the middle of the cut, not only after it; the witness must be at event 2 (the wheels are 100 mm further on at the end of the cut). A checker that locates only the first detachment of a cut misses it (safety-model 7.4; PHYS-18).
